Maya Patel: quick heads-up — PR #4821 updates SDK snippets for python / ts / go: streaming + pagination + retry examples. can someone sanity-check the python streaming retry pattern? cc @Samir @Evelyn
Samir Khan: looking now. i glanced at the go example — it cancels context on first error, which will close the stream unexpectedly. we should show a retry-with-backoff wrapper instead.
Evelyn Cho: for pagination: do we prefer cursor-style async iterator (yield pages) or list-all-with-generator? customers use both; examples should show both patterns briefly.
Theo Ruiz: i can add a tiny helper in ts that normalizes both cursor/page-token APIs into an async iterator. will open a tiny PR to the docs snippets folder.
docs-bot: PR #4821 opened by @maya — files changed: docs/sdk/snippets/python/streaming.md, docs/sdk/snippets/ts/pagination.md, docs/sdk/snippets/go/streaming_retry.md — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821
Maya Patel: thanks. Samir — can you paste suggested go snippet here? just a 6-8 line example so i can swap it in.
Samir Khan: sure. short go pattern (pseudo):
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
  err := stream.Recv(ctx)
  if err == nil { break }
  time.Sleep(time.Duration(attempt+1) * 200 * time.Millisecond)
}
```
Samir Khan: note: callers should distinguish EOF vs transient network error; mention that in the snippet text.
Evelyn Cho: python streaming note: show both sync and async variants. i suggest this minimal async pattern for retries:
```python
from tenacity import retry, wait_exponential, stop_after_attempt
@retry(wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=0.2), stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
async def fetch_stream(client, req):
    async for chunk in client.stream_completion(req):
        yield chunk
```
Evelyn Cho: add a short sentence advising not to retry non-idempotent ops.
Maya Patel: perfect — Theo can you add TS iterator helper + a one-liner showing how to consume it with streaming + pagination?
Theo Ruiz: yep. TS snippet i'll add: async generator that yields items across pages and wraps streaming responses. small, annotated.
Maya Patel: small editorial items: 1) update code fence languages (py, ts, go) 2) add link to SDK migration guide 3) add a short changelog note that retry semantics changed for streaming in v0.22.0
Samir Khan: flagged an edge-case comment on the PR about context deadlines — we should advise using client-side short-circuiting rather than killing background goroutines.
Maya Patel: awesome. i'll make a follow-up commit to tweak wording after Theo + Samir push snippets. thanks all :thumbsup:
